findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe attribute access
 * @description Using getattr/setattr/delattr with user-controlled input can lead to security issues
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/unsafe-attribute-access
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-915
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::builtin(["getattr", "setattr", "delattr", "hasattr"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe attribute access that could access private attributes."
findings.hypothesis: Check for unsafe use of getattr/setattr/delattr that could lead to attribute injection or access to private attributes
